```{r, message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
library(VennDiagram)
futile.logger::flog.threshold(futile.logger::ERROR, name = "VennDiagramLogger")
library(grid)

data_storage_folder = "../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm"
```

```{r}
other_anno = getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19, "Other") |> as.data.frame()
loc_anno = getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19, "Locations")  |> as.data.frame()
island_anno = getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19, "Islands.UCSC")  |> as.data.frame()
colnames(loc_anno) <- c("CHR","MAPINFO","STRAND")
full_anno <- merge(loc_anno, other_anno, by=0, all.x=T, sort=F)
full_anno <- merge(full_anno, island_anno, by.x="Row.names", by.y=0, all.x=T, sort=F)
rownames(full_anno) <- full_anno$Row.names

probes_450k <- rownames(subset(full_anno, Methyl450_Loci==TRUE))
```


```{r}
order_df <- function(d, column, decreasing = F) {return(d[order(d[[column]], decreasing = decreasing),])}
```

```{r}
all_hyper_cpg <- list()
all_hypo_cpg <- list()
```


# IM vs. healthy, only new (EPIC) samples

```{r}
load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_with_healthy_annotated.RData") )
im_vs_healthy_results <- all_results_betas_annotated[["IMvsNormalAntrum"]]
im_vs_healthy_results$gene_symbol = strsplit(im_vs_healthy_results$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";") |> sapply(function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=",") )
```

We use |log2FC| > 0.2 and FDR < 5% as thresholds to select hyper- and hypomethylated CpGs

```{r}
tmp = im_vs_healthy_results

hyper_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC > 0.20 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
hyper_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hyper_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

hypo_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC < -0.2 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
hypo_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hypo_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

#n = "IM_vs_nonIM_with_healthy"
n = "IM_vs_healthy"
all_hyper_cpg[[n]] <- hyper_cpg_592_594
all_hypo_cpg[[n]] <- hypo_cpg_592_594
```

We identified `r length(hyper_genes_592_594)` hypermethylated and `r length(hypo_genes_592_594)` hypomethylated genes. 

## Most frequently hypermethylated genes (Top 50)

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=8}
par(mar=c(5,10,4,1))
with(subset(hyper_cpg_592_594, gene_symbol!="") |> order_df("logFC"), table(gene_symbol) |> sort(decreasing = F)) |> tail(50) |> barplot(las=2, cex.names=.6, horiz=T, main="Most frequently hypermethylated genes")
```


## Most frequently hypomethylated genes (Top 50)

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=8}
par(mar=c(5,10,4,1))
with(subset(hypo_cpg_592_594, gene_symbol!="") |> order_df("logFC"), table(gene_symbol) |> sort(decreasing = F)) |> tail(50) |> barplot(las=2, cex.names=.6, horiz=T, main="Most frequently hypomethylated genes")
```

# IM vs. non-IM, normalized with healthy samples (EPIC)

```{r}
#load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_with_healthy_annotated.RData") )
im_nonim_healthy_results <- all_results_betas_annotated[["IMvsNonIM_592_594_avg"]]
im_nonim_healthy_results$gene_symbol = strsplit(im_nonim_healthy_results$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";") |> sapply(function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=",") )
```

We use |log2FC| > 0.2 and raw pvalue < 0.001 as thresholds to select hyper- and hypomethylated CpGs


```{r}
tmp = im_nonim_healthy_results

hyper_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC > 0.20 & P.Value < 0.001)
hyper_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hyper_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

hypo_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC < -0.2 & P.Value < 0.001)
hypo_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hypo_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

n = "IM_vs_nonIM_with_healthy"
all_hyper_cpg[[n]] <- hyper_cpg_592_594
all_hypo_cpg[[n]] <- hypo_cpg_592_594
```

We identified `r length(hyper_genes_592_594)` hypermethylated and `r length(hypo_genes_592_594)` hypomethylated genes. 

## Most frequently hypermethylated genes (Top 50)

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=8}
par(mar=c(5,10,4,1))
with(subset(hyper_cpg_592_594, gene_symbol!="") |> order_df("logFC"), table(gene_symbol) |> sort(decreasing = F)) |> tail(50) |> barplot(las=2, cex.names=.6, horiz=T, main="Most frequently hypermethylated genes")
```


## Most frequently hypomethylated genes (Top 50)

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=8}

with(subset(hypo_cpg_592_594, gene_symbol!="") |> order_df("logFC"), table(gene_symbol) |> sort(decreasing = F)) |> tail(50) |> barplot(las=2, cex.names=.6, horiz=T, main="Most frequently hypomethylated genes")
```

# Export

Gene/Cpg lists defined above are save to file *Methylation_DM_lists_IM_and_nonIM_vs_healthy.Rdata*.

```{r}
save(all_hyper_cpg, all_hypo_cpg, file=file.path(data_storage_folder, "Methylation_DM_lists_IM_and_nonIM_vs_healthy.Rdata"), compress=T)
```

# Overlaps - all three sets

```{r}
all_probes = all_results_betas_annotated[[1]]$Row.names |> as.character()
```


## Hypermethylated CpGs

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
grid.newpage()
x <- venn.diagram(lapply(all_hyper_cpg, function(x) x$Row.names[x$Row.names %in% all_probes]), filename = NULL, disable.logging = T, euler.d=T, 
                  fill = c("cornflowerblue", "green", "darkorchid1"),
                  cat.cex = .7)
grid.draw(x)
```


## Hypermethylated genes

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
grid.newpage()
gene_lists <- lapply(all_hyper_cpg, function(x) unique(subset(x, Row.names %in% all_probes)$gene_symbol))
x <- venn.diagram(gene_lists, filename = NULL, disable.logging = T, euler.d=T, 
                  fill = c("cornflowerblue", "green", "darkorchid1"),
                  cat.cex = .7)
grid.draw(x)
```

```{r}
ovlp <- calculate.overlap(gene_lists)
```



## Intersecting hypermethylated genes

### By CpG

```{r}
intersect = c()
for (n in names(all_hyper_cpg)) {
  if(length(intersect) ==0) {
    intersect = all_hyper_cpg[[n]]
    next
  } else {
    intersect = subset(intersect, Row.names %in% all_hyper_cpg[[n]]$Row.names) 
  }
}

intersect$gene_symbol |> table()

```

### By Gene

```{r}
intersect = c()
for (n in names(all_hyper_cpg)) {
  if(length(intersect) ==0) {
    intersect = all_hyper_cpg[[n]]
    next
  } else {
    intersect = subset(intersect, gene_symbol %in% all_hyper_cpg[[n]]$gene_symbol) 
  }
}

intersect$gene_symbol |> table() |> sort()
```
